name: genpark-personal-agent-interstitial-lactate-anaerobic-threshold-skill
title: Continuous Interstitial Lactate & Anaerobic Threshold Pacer Skill
description: Continuous lactate monitoring (CLM) interstitial fluid dynamics, onset of blood lactate accumulation (OBLA 4 mmol/L) shift, and endurance pacing governor. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: evaluate_interstitial_lactate_dynamics
tools.description: Assess continuous lactate telemetry (mmol/L) and identify current metabolic domain (Aerobic, Threshold, Severe).

tools.name: calculate_lactate_clearance_recovery_pace
tools.description: Calculate active recovery wattage to maximize monocarboxylate transporter (MCT1) lactate clearance.
